title: 大地之神的匣

titles.en: Casket of the God of the Earth

text: 祭坛是一整块没有接缝的石头。石面上凹进去一个拳头大的洞，里面是一只空心的石匣 —— 能装一件小东西。

texts.en: The altar is one seamless block of stone. A fist-sized hole is sunk into its face, and in it sits a hollow stone casket, big enough for one small thing.

outcomes.text: 大地之神的护符沉甸甸的，是个空匣子。

texts.en: The charm of the God of the Earth sits heavy in your hand. It's an empty casket.
